text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, I saw Fuji Kiseki and T.M. Opera 
O talking together.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Putting on a performance of an original 
work with all of us, huh...? Yeah, that 
sounds thoroughly delightful!"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"I saw the script the other day, but―― 
come to think of it, what are we doing 
about the casting?"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha, isn't it obvious?! Starring me! 
Directed by me! Produced by me! In short: 
ME!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Never mind obvious things like that; what 
matters right now is you, Fuji-senpai!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
A beauty that rivals even my own, and the 
sheer performance power to captivate the 
crowd—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Where do we showcase Senpai's natural 
talent as a "Star"!? That is the question!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I'm glad you think so highly of me.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: That said, my role, huh... Hmm—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ah. Hey, Trainer, what do you think?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"...Senpai, even if he is your Trainer, he 
truly looks like nothing more than a 
'passerby.'"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"...Senpai, even if she is your Trainer, 
she truly looks like nothing more than a 
'passerby.'"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Giving them the authority to decide the 
casting amidst all that... isn't that a 
bit, how should I put it, rough?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's fine. It's already been 
decided that you're the star of this 
stage, right, Opera O?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, whatever role I must play, 
I will fulfill it completely to bring out 
your best and make you shine."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Because that's how an entertainer known 
as an actor ought to be."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
And so, wild ideas are totally welcome♪ Go 
ahead and tell me, Trainer!
choice_data_list: The Narrator Who Brings the Story to Life

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
That's quite an unexpected casting 
choice...! Senpai, do you have any 
experience?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It might not be a lot. But like I said, 
I'll see it through with everything I've 
got!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
If you wish, shall I demonstrate it right 
here? *ahem*—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—Oh, my prince. What meaning is there in 
such a thing as destiny?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"God tells us to love the one bound to us 
by the chains of destiny. But where is the 
love in that, I ask you?!"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I choose you. Seeing your gallant demeanor 
with these eyes, hearing your uplifting 
voice with these ears—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
My heart points to no one else but you! It 
is you, and only you, that I wish to 
choose!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: ...! Th-This is—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"...I shall sever these chains with my 
blade. No manner of hardship or suffering 
shall shatter my will."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
That you and I are tightly bound together, 
heart to heart! I won't let anyone get in 
the way of that—!

text_block_list.name: Students
text_block_list.text:
Wheeeeeew!! *Clap clap clap!!* What was 
that just now~?! Both of you were 
incredible...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Before I knew it, I was clapping with 
total abandon. That was just how 
captivated I was!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, what a huge fuss it's become. 
That's Opera O for you, though.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Heh... Cut the modesty, Senpai!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Made to perform"—no, I too felt that "my 
performance was drawn out of me".

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, what an adorable, yet terrifying 
heroine she was...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki plays the gallant heroine with 
effortless grace. I don't know when the 
performance will be, but I'll believe that 
I'll get to see it.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"The narrator...!? You're putting Senpai 
in a position that isn't even an actual 
role?!"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
You think so? The narrator is an important 
role too. After all, some plays can't 
exist without one.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Very well, let me show you then. The 
"black-clad narrator" who will stir the 
audience's very souls.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: *Ahem*—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
What begins now is the tale of a prince 
who carves a path of supremacy through his 
might—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
...!! Oh, what powerful recitation...! As 
expected of a senior, quite impressive!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Where the prince, single-mindedly seeking 
power, is headed— will it be glory, or 
ruin?!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Isn't that wonderful! Magnificent! The 
scene practically leaps out before my 
eyes!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The prince who aspires to be the Supreme 
Overlord runs like a gale!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Mm-hmm...! Exactly!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Whether on the straight or on a curve, her 
running speed never dropped for a second!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
O-Of course! If the narration demands it, 
I shall carry it out!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
And yet, she hasn't broken a single drop 
of sweat... Truly, she is one worthy of 
striving to become the Supreme Overlord!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Mmmgh... No, I can do it! I know I can!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Nwoooooooo~h!!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Now, can the Prince rise to become the 
Overlord...? The answer is blowin' in the 
wind, as they say♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki seemed to be enjoying herself 
as she breezily spun her tale. I don't 
know when the performance will be, but 
I'll believe that I'll get to see it 
someday.
